title: Ireland · Ring of Kerry Touring Day
slogan: A 161 km loop out of Moll’s Gap
story: Atlantic edges and Irish touring rhythm. A 161 km loop that starts and ends near Kenmare, about 3 h 06 of riding. On the way it passes Waterville coast and Kerry cliffs. Moll’s Gap is the high point. The passes are the reason to go.

title: Dublin · Wicklow Mountains and Glendalough
slogan: A 120 km loop out of Sally Gap
story: Bog road light, ancient stones and a close-to-city classic. A 99 km loop that starts and ends near Blessington, about 1 h 54 of riding. It goes by way of Glendalough and Laragh. Wicklow Gap is the high point. The passes are the reason to go.
